stem_en: I ____ a student.
explain_en: Use 是 (shì) to state identity: 我是学生 (I am a student).

stem_en: How are ____ ?
explain_en: 你好吗? asks about the listener, so use 你 (you).

stem_en: There is one ____ of book on the table.
explain_en: The measure word for books is 本: 一本书 (one book).

stem_en: He is ____ watching TV.
explain_zh: 「正在」表示动作进行中：正在看电视。
explain_en: 正在 marks an action in progress: 正在看电视 (is watching TV).

stem_en: Today is ____ than yesterday.
explain_zh: 「比」字句里形容词前不用「很」：今天比昨天冷。
explain_en: In 比 comparisons, don't use 很 before the adjective: 今天比昨天冷.

stem_zh: 虽然下雨，____ 我还是去了。
stem_en: Although it rained, ____ I still went.
explain_en: 虽然…但是… is a concessive pair (although…still/but…).

stem_en: Please ____ the door.
explain_zh: 「把」字句：把门关上。「关上」是动词+结果补语。
explain_en: In the 把 construction: 把门关上 (close the door); 关上 = verb + result complement.

stem_zh: 这本书 ____ 那本有意思。
stem_en: This book is more interesting ____ that one.
explain_zh: 比较用「比」：这本书比那本有意思。
explain_en: Use 比 for comparison: 这本书比那本有意思 (more interesting than).

stem_en: He works conscientiously and is never ____ .
explain_en: 马虎 (mǎhu) means careless/sloppy.

stem_zh: 这个问题很复杂，我们需要进一步 ____ 。
stem_en: This issue is complex; we need to ____ further.
explain_en: 讨论 (tǎolùn) means to discuss / exchange views.

stem_zh: ____ 天气不好，比赛还是照常进行。
stem_en: ____ the weather was bad, the match went ahead as usual.
explain_en: 尽管…还是… expresses concession (even though…still…).

stem_zh: 为了 ____ 时间，我们坐了飞机。
stem_en: To ____ time, we took a plane.
explain_zh: 「节省时间」是常用搭配，意为减少花费的时间。
explain_en: 节省时间 (jiéshěng shíjiān) = to save time, a common collocation.

stem_zh: 他不但学习好，____ 很热心助人。
stem_en: He not only studies well, ____ is also helpful to others.
explain_en: 不但…而且… expresses progression (not only…but also…).

stem_zh: 这件事让他 ____ ，不知道该怎么办。
stem_en: This matter left him ____ , not knowing what to do.
explain_zh: 「左右为难」形容两方面都难处理、很难抉择。
explain_en: 左右为难 (zuǒyòu-wéinán) = caught in a dilemma.

stem_zh: 经过这次失败，他 ____ 了很多经验。
stem_en: After this failure, he ____ a lot of experience.
explain_zh: 「积累经验」是常用搭配，指逐渐聚集。
explain_en: 积累经验 (jīlěi jīngyàn) = to accumulate experience.

stem_zh: 他的建议很有 ____ ，值得认真考虑。
stem_en: His suggestion has real ____ and is worth considering.
explain_zh: 「价值」指意义、作用；价格是钱数，代价是付出。
explain_en: 价值 = value/worth; 价格 = price; 代价 = cost paid.

stem_zh: 面对困难，他从不 ____ ，总是积极想办法。
stem_en: Facing difficulties, he never ____ , always seeking solutions.
explain_zh: 「退缩」指因害怕困难而向后缩、不敢前进。
explain_en: 退缩 (tuìsuō) = to shrink back / flinch from difficulty.

stem_zh: 这部纪录片 ____ 地展现了大自然的美。
stem_en: The documentary ____ portrays the beauty of nature.
explain_zh: 「生动」形容描写真实而有感染力；活泼多形容人或气氛。
explain_en: 生动 (shēngdòng) = vivid/lifelike (of depiction); 活泼 describes people/mood.

stem_zh: 他的发言 ____ 了大家的强烈反响。
stem_en: His speech ____ a strong response from everyone.
explain_zh: 「引起反响」是常用搭配，意为导致、激起。
explain_en: 引起反响 (yǐnqǐ fǎnxiǎng) = to provoke/arouse a response.

stem_zh: 他对这座城市还不 ____ ，经常迷路。
stem_en: He isn't ____ with this city yet and often gets lost.
explain_zh: 「熟悉」指对人或事物了解得清楚。
explain_en: 熟悉 (shúxī) = familiar with (people/places/things).

stem_en: I ____ Chinese.
explain_en: 是 (shì) states identity.

stem_en: What time is it now?
explain_en: 几点 (jǐ diǎn) asks the time.

stem_en: I have three ___ books.
explain_en: 本 (běn) is the measure word for books.

stem_en: Yesterday I ___ a book.
explain_en: 买了 (mǎi le) marks a completed action.

stem_en: He is taller ___ me.
explain_zh: 「A 比 B + 形容词」表比较。
explain_en: A 比 (bǐ) B + adjective expresses comparison.

stem_en: Have you ___ been to Beijing?
explain_en: 去过 (qù guo) expresses past experience.

stem_zh: 这个问题我 ____ 解决了。
stem_en: I have ___ solved this problem.
explain_en: 已经…了 means "already".

stem_en: ___ it rained, we still went.
explain_en: 虽然…还是 = "although… still".

stem_en: He speaks Chinese ___ fluently.
explain_en: 非常 (fēicháng) = "very / extremely".

stem_en: This matter ___ be handled by me.
explain_en: 由 (yóu) indicates who is responsible.

stem_en: The weather is getting ___ colder.
explain_en: 越来越 = "more and more".

stem_en: No matter how hard, he never gives up.
explain_en: 无论…都 = "no matter… always".

stem_zh: 这部电影 ____ 我深受感动。
stem_en: This film ___ me deeply moved.
explain_en: 使 (shǐ) = "to make/cause".

stem_en: ___ you work hard, you will succeed.
explain_en: 只要…就 = "as long as… then".

stem_en: His plan is ___ feasible.
explain_en: 完全 (wánquán) = "completely".

stem_en: Facing hardship, he ___ and pushed forward.
explain_zh: 成语式表达「毫不退缩」＝一点也不退。
explain_en: 毫不退缩 = "without flinching at all".

stem_zh: 这项改革 ____ 了经济发展。
stem_en: This reform ___ economic growth.
explain_en: 促进 (cùjìn) = "to promote / boost".

stem_zh: 他的演讲 ____ ，赢得满堂掌声。
stem_en: His speech was ___, winning applause.
explain_en: 精彩绝伦 = "superbly brilliant".

stem_en: I ___ a student.
explain_en: 是 = to be.

stem_en: How are you?
explain_en: 吗 marks a yes/no question.

stem_en: The weather is very ___ today.
explain_en: 很 + adjective: 很好.

stem_en: He is ___ than me.
explain_en: In 比 comparisons, no 很 before the adjective.

stem_en: This shirt is more expensive ___ that one.
explain_zh: 「A 比 B + 形容词」表示比较。
explain_en: A 比 B + adj expresses comparison.

stem_en: I have ___ never been to Beijing.
explain_zh: 「还没……（过）」表示到现在仍未发生。
explain_en: 还没…(过) = still have not done.

stem_zh: 经过努力，他 ____ 通过了考试。
stem_en: After hard work, he ___ passed the exam.
explain_zh: 「终于」表示经过过程后实现，含期待。
explain_en: 终于 = finally, after a process.

stem_en: This problem is ___ complex.
explain_en: 相当 = quite / considerably.

stem_en: He works very ___, never careless.
explain_en: 认真 = conscientious / serious.

stem_zh: 听到这个好消息，大家都 ____ 不已。
stem_en: Everyone was ___ at the good news.
explain_zh: 固定搭配「兴奋不已」＝非常激动。
explain_en: 兴奋不已 = thrilled beyond measure.

stem_zh: 面对困难，他始终 ____ ，毫不退缩。
stem_en: Facing hardship, he always ___, never flinching.
explain_en: 迎难而上 = rise to the challenge.

stem_zh: 这部小说情节 ____ ，引人入胜。
stem_en: The plot of the novel is ___, gripping.
explain_zh: 「跌宕起伏」＝起落变化大，扣人心弦。
explain_en: 跌宕起伏 = full of ups and downs.
